m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read inherited global-crew.md + global-everyone.md, the handoff, the target script and tests, and the workbench engine reference. Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, evidence, test mode, stop conditions). Record the pre-change baseline (full suite green).

postconditions.statement: doctrine + handoff loaded; handoff complete; baseline 375 tests green recorded

m1-red.title: TDD red: author failing tests for dedup + same-epoch guard
m1-red.imperative: Add tests to tests/test_apply_lessons_delta.py covering: (1) same work-id ticks age a lesson once; (2) distinct work-ids age twice; (3) burst of same-work-id ticks cannot expire a lesson; (4) same-epoch guard blocks expiry when added==tick date and when last-confirmed==tick date; (5) later-dated tick still expires; (6) seen-work-ids header field migrates + round-trips + bounded ~50; (7) malformed field raises. Update test_tick_auto_deletes_unconfirmed to use a prior-dated added (same-day expiry is now forbidden). Run the new tests and OBSERVE them failing against current code.

postconditions.statement: new tests authored; observed RED against unmodified script (evidence attached)

constraints: only tests/test_apply_lessons_delta.py touched in this step

m2-green.title: TDD green: implement dedup + same-epoch guard + header field
m2-green.imperative: In scripts/apply_lessons_delta.py: extend STATE_RE + Playbook + load/render for a bounded (~50) ticked-work-ids header field; gate tick aging on the work_id being unseen (record it when it ages); add a same-epoch guard so a lesson whose added or last-confirmed date equals the tick date is never auto-deleted. Fail visibly on malformed field. Constellation stays pinned; ripeness/run_tick meaning verified unchanged.
constraints: mechanism not quality — dedup by string identity + date-string equality only
do not touch .agent-work/LESSONS.md or excluded files

m3-suite.title: Full suite green + refactor while green
m3-suite.imperative: Refactor for clarity while green if warranted, then run the full suite to confirm no regression.

postconditions.statement: full suite green (no regression vs 375 baseline)
